% Real PDF alignment fixture: one shared square used beside Greek capitals
% and mathematical units, at the ordinary body size and at small size.
\documentclass[11pt,twoside,openright]{book}
\input{config/book-config.tex}
\newif\ifBookTwoInkProof
\ifdefined\CheckboxesPrint
  \BookTwoInkProoftrue
\else
  \BookTwoInkProoffalse
\fi
\newif\ifPrintThreeInk
\PrintThreeInkfalse
\usepackage{styles/universalbook}
\pagestyle{empty}
\newcommand{\CheckboxFixtureRow}[3]{%
  \begingroup
  #2\relax
  % Independent typographic reference. Compare this measured capital height
  % with the resulting vectors and text origins in the generated PDF.
  \setbox0=\hbox{Σ}%
  \typeout{CHECKCAP:#1:\the\ht0}%
  \noindent #1\quad #3\par
  \vspace{10mm}%
  \endgroup
}
\begin{document}
\CheckboxFixtureRow{NORMALTF}{\normalsize}{\TrueFalseChoices}
\CheckboxFixtureRow{NORMALMC}{\normalsize}{%
  \CheckSquare\ $\mathrm{m}$\qquad
  \CheckSquare\ $\mathrm{m/s}$\qquad
  \CheckSquare\ $\mathrm{m/s^2}$}
\CheckboxFixtureRow{SMALLTF}{\small}{\TrueFalseChoices}
\CheckboxFixtureRow{SMALLMC}{\small}{%
  \CheckSquare\ $\mathrm{m}$\qquad
  \CheckSquare\ $\mathrm{m/s}$\qquad
  \CheckSquare\ $\mathrm{m/s^2}$}
\end{document}
